topic: Root Navigation Architecture Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis

models_evaluated.description: Discover (Atlas), Map (Spatial & Transit Layers), Plan (Solver & AI), Trips (Active Itinerary & Saved Places), You (Offline, Essentials, Contributions, Settings)
models_evaluated.ponytail_assessment: WINNER. Elevating 'Trips' gives the active traveler an immediate home for their current itinerary, next bus leg, and saved bookmarks without hiding them inside Settings/Profile. Transit directory is integrated into Discover, Map layers, and Plan hops without consuming a permanent dedicated root slot.

models_evaluated.description: Home (Landing Feed), Explore (Catalog & Filter), Plan (Itinerary), Trips (Saved), You (Settings). Map is relegated to contextual modals only.
models_evaluated.ponytail_assessment: REJECTED. Home and Explore are redundant duplicates in an editorial atlas. Demoting Map to contextual only severely handicaps Odisha's 30-district spatial exploration (Job 6).

models_evaluated.description: M0 Draft Model. Dedicated Transit tab for 154 routes; Trips and Saved Places nested inside 'You'.
models_evaluated.ponytail_assessment: RUNNER-UP / REVISED. While transit is an O-TRAVELZ pillar, a static route directory is consulted less frequently than an active traveler's itinerary and saved places. Nesting active trips in 'You' overloads Profile and creates friction during active transit execution.

models_evaluated.description: Home + Discover split; Plan invoked contextually from places or trips.
models_evaluated.ponytail_assessment: REJECTED. De-emphasizes deterministic itinerary planning (Job 3) which is O-TRAVELZ's primary AI differentiator.

authoritative_decision.transit_placement: Transit Directory (154 routes, 1,430 stops) is elevated as a prominent top-level module within Discover, a dedicated filterable layer on the Map, and the backbone of the Plan and Trips engines. This eliminates the redundancy of a separate lonely directory tab while making transit universally accessible across all contexts.
